clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Hilary searches for the necklace she lost in Lake Everstill. Her father gave it to her when she was young, and it slipped beneath the water while she and the other children fished by the docks.

Hilary lost her necklace while fishing with her friend Shawn along the Lakeshire shore. Her father had given it to her, and she treasures the gift. Fierce beasts and aggressive murlocs live in the lake's depths, so local children stay on the docks. The necklace remains beneath the water, buried in the lakebed silt.
